name: Cannon Blow
doc: Cannon Blow (enemy attack 69, the Galbadian soldiers' SAM08G; the Cronos mod's item Grenade): the root and the main task - a fire ball shot on a curve from in front of the caster to near the targets' centre with its flash, burst, ring and fire trails, then an impact, its rings and debris at the targets, the camera shake; the damage at counter 30. Not the game's: the smoke grenade options (Smoke grenade 1: a canister and its smoke trail on the curve, a smoke cloud at the landing; it needs a texture with the smoke puffs and their grey row - Cronos's Smoke Grenade, 360). Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag151_cannon_blow.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particle tables, curve and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Shot
parts.doc: The game's Cannon Blow: a fire ball shot on a curve from in front of the caster to near the targets' centre, its flash, burst, ring and fire trails, an impact, rings and debris at the targets, the camera shake; the damage at counter 30; its sound and texture, the camera track. The smoke grenade's switch and timing

parts.title: Canister
parts.doc: Smoke grenade: a small dark canister spinning along the shot's curve in place of the fire ball

parts.title: Smoke trail
parts.doc: Smoke grenade: puffs the canister leaves along its way, growing, rising and fading out

parts.title: Smoke cloud
parts.doc: Smoke grenade: puffs billowing out of the landing point, slowing, swelling, rising, then thinning out

params.label: Shot
params.doc: At the main task's counter 1

params.label: Smoke grenade
params.doc: 0: the game's Cannon Blow. 1: a smoke grenade - no fire, flash or explosion: a canister, its smoke trail, a smoke cloud at the landing (a new effect's look; the next values)

params.label: Smoke palette row
params.doc: The puffs' palette row (VRAM y): the smoke texture's grey ramp, brightness = opacity (the game's texture has no such row: row 249 of a smoke texture)

params.label: Holds for
params.doc: Ticks after the landing before a cloud puff starts thinning out (+ the next random)

params.label: Holds, random
params.doc: Up to this many more ticks, each puff its own

params.label: Thins out over
params.doc: Ticks a puff takes to vanish

params.label: Puffs
params.doc: How many puffs the cloud has (256 at most, shared with the trail)

params.label: Released over
params.doc: The puffs come out over this many ticks after the landing, at random

params.label: Start spread
params.doc: Each puff starts this far (at most) from the landing point, sideways

params.label: Speed
params.doc: Outward speed at the start (units a tick; + the next random)

params.label: Rise
params.doc: Upward speed at the start (units a tick; + the next random)

params.label: Slows by
params.doc: A tick the speeds lose 1 / this of themselves (small = stops fast)

params.label: Size at the start
params.doc: 4096 = the puff picture's own size (64 texels x 16 units)

params.label: Size
params.doc: The size a puff grows to (+ the next random)

params.label: Grows by
params.doc: A tick a puff grows 1 / this of what it still lacks

params.label: Picture
params.doc: The flipbook frame a puff shows (+ the next random; the frame stays)

params.label: Spin
params.doc: A puff turns up to this much a tick, either way (the trail's too)

params.label: Drifts up
params.doc: Once slowed, a puff still rises this much a tick

params.label: Sway
params.doc: A random push sideways a tick (the cloud churning)

params.label: Swells
params.doc: A puff keeps growing this much a tick (x 16)

params.label: Red
params.doc: The grey added (128 = the texture as it is)

params.label: Thickness
params.doc: How much of what is behind a puff it hides (x the texel / 128; at least the grey, or the puffs pile up to white)

params.label: Shade, random

params.label: Lighter on top
params.doc: A puff is this much lighter for every 1000 units over the floor (256 = twice)

params.label: Size
params.doc: 4096 = the puff picture's own size

params.label: Spin

params.label: Grey

params.label: Picture

params.label: Size
